goal: Lower held-out cross-entropy through useful learned depth and width allocation in MoRE-Core and MoRE-RM.

metric.aggregation: Token-weighted mean across the three predeclared windows.
metric.holdout_boundary: Token-disjoint from the entire sealed training sampler, not a document-deduplicated holdout.
comparison_requirements: Identical tensor-window hashes and training-token counts.
Report actual modeled compute, vocabulary work, and measured runtime.
Do not interpret training-window loss or frozen-head adaptation as full-model convergence.
Acceptance windows are not inspected or used to choose candidate recipes.

baseline.original_core_excluded: The original lineage had disconnected routed-expert learning and is not a valid baseline.

candidate_hypotheses.name: three-pass-support
candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: Restrict the learned horizon to three passes, avoiding poorly trained fourth/fifth-pass plans.

candidate_hypotheses.name: context-floor
candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: Keep all tokens in the second-pass context while learning additional depth and expert width under the unchanged cost cap.
candidate_hypotheses.boundary: This intentionally excludes one-pass exits; it is a conservative architecture ablation, not a claim that arbitrary early exits are repaired.

candidate_hypotheses.name: router-capacity
candidate_hypotheses.hypothesis: A wider controller may better fit action-dependent outcomes.
candidate_hypotheses.boundary: Charge the larger router against the same budget and do not change backbone initialization.

research.title: CHASE
research.relevance: Actual token skipping changes SSM state dynamics; fixed-depth pretraining alone does not create competent intermediate exits.
research.boundary: Its executable skipping results concern pure Mamba, not this attention-Mamba hybrid.

research.title: AdaPonderLM
research.relevance: Staged gate/backbone optimization and preservation of halted-token attention context.
research.boundary: Does not establish a successful jointly learned depth-and-expert-width terminal critic.

research.title: LoopMoE
research.relevance: Useful recurrence requires appropriate conditioning and capacity allocation.
research.boundary: Uses fixed recurrences and fixed routed expert count; not evidence of adaptive width superiority.

preserve: Other architecture repairs and concurrent edits.
Existing running and queued jobs and their source trees.
Release inputs and original experiment artifacts.
Existing dependencies and linear main history.
scope.deployment: Committed immutable experiment sources; no changes to live source trees.
scope.promotion: Retain proven correctness repairs; promote architecture changes only with measured evidence.
